id.description: Unique identifier assigned by the integration-event building block.

creationDate.description: UTC timestamp when the integration event was created.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order whose submitted basket could not be deleted.

basketId.description: Identifier of the basket that could not be deleted.

email.description: Customer email used by downstream recovery or notification workflows.

totalMoney.description: Total purchase amount associated with the order.
